_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: McGraw Hill Financial 'is a leading benchmarks and ratings, analytics, data and research provider serving the global capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: McGraw Hill Financial 'is a leading benchmarks and ratings, analytics, data and research provider serving the global capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.44x; +23% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.15; conservative 2yr +14%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -39.1%/yr (worst year FY06-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.8%/yr (Q4 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +9.8%/yr (FY06-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MHFI (retrospective, 2016-03-04) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.44x (71.6% downside to Bear $27 / +29.4% upside to Bull $123) | Adj composite 2.70 vs market 2.85: gap -0.15 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +23% above the EPP floor $77 (17x FY16E $4.53) | Conservative 2-yr case: +13.8% total (+6.9%/yr) | At 21.0x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $126 sits above the BULL case; Financial Services revenue +5.3% in Q4 2015, forward revenues +6.5% (no FY16 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2015 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
